description:
If you've been searching for a spacious, affordable home that doesn't compromise on style or functionality, this could be exactly what you've been looking for. In this full walkthrough, we'll take you room by room through the Solution. A beautifully designed 4 bed 2 bath home with approximately 1,530 sq. ft. of thoughtfully planned living space. From the open concept living area and modern kitchen to the spacious bedrooms and private primary suite, this home was built with families in mind. 

Whether you're buying your first home, upgrading for more space, or simply exploring your options, this tour will show you why the Solution has become one of our most popular homes.

(325)676-9700
Palm Harbor Homes of Abilene
3301 Hickory St., Abilene, Tx 79601
